Although the Bar Council of India (BCI) had made AIBE mandatory for law graduates from 2009-10 onwards, the requirement had not been formally implemented for advocates enrolled with the Bar Council of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. The Jammu and Kashmir High Court has now directed its implementation. A notification to this effect was issued by the High Court's Registrar General MK Sharma on October 10, 2026.
